page.layout: One column of text, set in roman and italic with Greek verb forms. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. Catchword at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.head: Quid est secunda forma?
main_text.p: Secunda forma est quando thema definit in μι, ac si Græcè flecti possit in ω vel μι, dicitur verbum passivum. τύπτομαι, verberor τύπτω, verbero: πήμι, ponor, τίθημι, pono. In secunda forma sunt tria præsentia tempora, unum imperfectum, tria perfecta, unum plus quam perfectum, tex indefinita, decem futura.
main_text.head: Conjuga verba formæ secundæ.
Primum præsens tempus.
main_text.l: τύπτομαι, verberor, τύπτῃ, verberar s vel are, τύπτεῖ.
τίθεμαι, ponor, τίθεται, poneris vel re, τίθεται.
main_text.head: Secundum præsens tempus.
main_text.l: Εἴθε τυπτοίμην, utinam verberer, τυπτοῖο, τυπτοῖτο.
Εἴθε πθέαμην, utinam ponar, πθέο, πθεῖτο.
Εἴθε ἱσταίμην, utinam sistar, ἱσταῖο, ἱσταῖτο.
Εἴθε διδοίμην, utinam tradar, διδοῖο, διδοῖτο.

page.notes: The catchword at lower right reads roughly "διδόμε-" and is uncertain. Greek accents and breathings in the verb paradigms are hard to read at this scan resolution, and several forms are marked [?] or left as read. Some Greek lines, especially in the middle paradigm, are only approximately legible. The partly cut-off Greek word at the right margin is treated as the catchword.
